Chapter 1293 - 39: Unfathomable Power

Chapter 1293: Chapter 39: Unfathomable Power

The Golden Mist Treasure Land.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged there.

Not far away, irregular cracks connecting to the Origin Source of the Source World were gradually healing completely.

"Is it over?"

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but feel regret.

Directly observing the operation of the Source World’s Origin Source greatly enhanced his understanding of his own Dao rules, all the time, rapidly improving.

Unfortunately, this opportunity could only be encountered at the birth of a new treasure land.

The relationship between the treasure land and the Source World is like that between a mother tree and its fruit.

Before the fruit completely separates from the mother tree, through the connection between them, one can slightly observe the most essential area of the mother tree.

Once completely detached, this connection breaks, and naturally, everything returns to its original state.

Under normal circumstances, it takes several hundred to tens of thousands of years for a treasure land to completely sever its connection with the Source World after its birth.

The specific duration depends on the level of the treasure land.

As a top-tier treasure land, the Golden Mist Treasure Land had maintained its connection with the Source World for over ten thousand years.

"It’s a pity that the crack passages connecting to the Source World’s Origin cannot be forcibly opened."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, even ancestors, with their life levels, could directly sense the operation of the Source World’s Origin.

However, if one were to open the crack passage penetrating into the Source World’s Origin, they would suffer the backlash from the entire Source World.

Such backlash is not something any lifespan can withstand for long.

Of course, if Lin Yuan truly requested, the six ancestors would risk being suppressed by the backlash of the Source World.

They would forcibly open the crack passage connecting to the Origin Source Land.

But by doing so,

Lin Yuan would owe a great debt of gratitude.

Moreover, after over ten thousand years of comprehension, Lin Yuan believed he had reached the pinnacle in all aspects.

Continuing to observe the operation of the Source World’s Origin was far less beneficial than the previous ten thousand years.

"A millennium of arduous cultivation and seclusion has greatly enhanced me."

Lin Yuan smiled.

At his level, even ten thousand years, let alone billions or trillions of years, might leave one’s strength stagnant.

But Lin Yuan was different. His insight defied the heavens, coupled with the advantages accumulated from different dimensional spaces, his strength underwent a qualitative transformation over millennia.

"Time and space..."

Within Lin Yuan’s sight, the time and space of the Golden Mist Treasure Land, and that of the outer world, were in perfect order, like fine threads running through the world.

With a single thought, Lin Yuan could influence and control them.

If he wished, he could trigger a time-space storm within the Source World, annihilating ninety percent of the life forms.

Two thousand years ago, Lin Yuan had achieved a complete transformation in understanding the spatiotemporal fusion rule, comprehending the Spacetime Great Dao.

The Spacetime Great Dao, a realm one can only touch upon reaching the thirteenth tier; at this level, I am time and space, and time and space are me.

In the past, Xuanhuang himself had reached the ninth realm’s limit in terms of accumulation in time and space.

After acquiring the thirteenth-grade weapon, the Sky Void Tripod, and observing its intricacies within, he barely stepped into the spatiotemporal fusion rule by half a step.

But Lin Yuan had made a complete step forward, equalling temporal life in his understanding of time and space.

"Every dimension and dimensional plane has time and space; time and space are the foundation of all heavens and the vast worlds."

Lin Yuan continued scrutinizing the time-space lines within his vision, growing more amazed the more he observed.

Countless time-space threads formed a kind of balance; it was because of this balance that a stable environment was created, giving birth to innumerable lives.

"The Supreme Origin Dao?"

Lin Yuan looked pensive.

At his current level, he could already sense a force running through endless dimensional planes, maintaining the basic operation of all heavens and vast worlds.

Although countless time-space threads show a single error, they would lead to disaster, yet over long epochs, without external interference, time and space remain exceedingly stable.

Clearly, there is a higher power at play.

This higher power is what the six ancestors referred to as the Supreme Origin Dao.

Even the thirteenth-grade temporal life forms are comprehending this Dao.

"My life level is still too low."

Lin Yuan felt for a while and shook his head slightly.

He could indeed perceive this all-pervading power, but it was still very vague.

"The Supreme Origin Dao is still far from me. With this energy, I might as well comprehend the Chaos Taiji Dao to the third level."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts narrowed.

Eight thousand years ago, he had stepped into the Second Realm in the Chaos Taiji Dao.

Five thousand years ago, his comprehension of the Chaos Taiji Dao reached the pinnacle of the Second Realm.

Until now, he was still trapped at the pinnacle of the Second Realm.

Just a half-step away from the perfect Third Realm.

Compared to the elusive Supreme Origin Dao,

realizing the Third Level of the Chaos Taiji Dao was easier and more helpful for Lin Yuan.

The first Source World divides the road of chaotic evolutionary power into three levels.

Among them, the Third Level is the perfect realm; this Source World, generally unsupported by an internal universe, compares to and matches the cultivators of the Chaos Void, depending on a higher-level chaotic evolutionary power road.

The Chaos Taiji Dao is unknowably more potent than other chaotic evolutionary power paths. Its premise, alone, is the Chaos Rule Second Realm Peak.

Comprehending the Chaos Taiji Dao to the Third Level is countless times harder than anyone else’s chaotic evolutionary power road to the Third Level.

Even Lin Yuan was momentarily stuck at this bottleneck.

Hoo!

Lin Yuan’s mind subtly shifted.

He descended into his internal universe.

Overlooking the boundless internal universe.

Now his internal universe was equivalent to the size of thousands of Void Domains.

Vast and unending.
